notes: Shopify storefront: home and robots reachable; robots.txt restricts some crawler paths. Oct 18 crawl: home page returned HTTP 429 ("local_rate_limited") to the AgentReady bot UA and to a GPTBot UA, including a retry after the 60-second Retry-After window, while a browser UA got the full page; robots.txt unchanged. Bot access held pending a retest from a second network. Oct 18 retest: the 429 is user-agent based, not IP rate limiting. From the same IP within seconds, crawler UAs (AgentReadyBot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, Googlebot, bingbot) got 429 "local_rate_limited" (Cloudflare edge, Retry-After 60, persisted past it) while browser, curl, a non-"bot" AgentReady UA and PerplexityBot got 200. GPTBot still gets 200 on robots.txt, sitemap.xml and products.json; robots.txt has no AI-crawler blocks. Other Shopify stores show the same pattern, so this looks like platform-level unverified-crawler filtering. A bot-UA retest from a second network is still pending, so bot access stays 19 under the method. Oct 25 crawl: home page returned HTTP 200 to the AgentReady bot UA and a GPTBot UA (the Oct 18 429 did not recur for crawler UAs; a browser UA got one 429 in a spot check, so the edge filtering looks intermittent).
